T: › [ T ] to sell or to work regularly at something, especially at a job that involves selling things
經常從事（尤指賣東西的工作）；兜售

NONE: › to try to get customers for your business in a public place, for example, as a taxi driver, by driving around or waiting in a regular place

I + adv/prep, T: › [ I + adv/prep,  T ] old-fashioned When a boat, train, bus, etc. plies a particular route, it makes that journey regularly.

NONE: › the particular number of threads from which wool, rope, etc. is made, used as a measure of its thickness
› the particular number of layers from which plywood or tissue is formed, used as a measure of its thickness

example: Fishermen in small boats ply their trade up and down the coast.
漁民們駕著小船沿著海岸兜售海鮮。
Dealers are openly plying drugs in school playgrounds.
毒品販子公然在校園操場上兜售毒品。
The market traders were loudly plying their wares.
市場上的商販們在高聲叫賣他們的商品。
UK There are never any taxis plying for trade/hire in our area.
我們這一地區從來都沒有計程車在這裡候客。
I noticed a couple of prostitutes plying for business on the corner.
我看到轉角處有幾個妓女在拉客。
High-speed trains regularly ply between Paris and Lyons.
高速列車定期往返於巴黎和里昂之間。
This airline has been plying the transatlantic route for many years.
這家航空公司經營跨大西洋航線已經很多年了。
What ply do you need for that knitting pattern?
那個編結樣式需要用幾股毛線？
Will three-ply (= woolmade from three layers stuck together) be strong enough for making a shelf?
三層夾板搭的架子是否夠堅固？

NONE: › to keep giving a person something, usually food or drink
持續向（某人）提供（通常指食物、飲料）
› to keep giving someone work or forms to complete, or asking them questions
拿（工作、表格或問題）糾纏（某人）；不停地讓（某人）回答（問題）

example: John's been plying me with drinks all evening.
約翰整個晚上都在給我倒酒。
We plied Charlie with questions about his trip round the world.
我們不停地問查理他環遊世界的事情。

NONE: › wood that consists of several thin layers of wood stuck together

example: a box made of plywood
合板做的盒子
a cheap plywood door
廉價的三夾板門
